notes.title: Sign in India, not Jakarta
notes.body: Bank SBI Indonesia is a separate Indonesian company, not an SBI branch, so it cannot execute documents for your Indian loan. You land in India on 7 November and the in-principle offer expires on the 12th, which leaves a five-day window. - Tell the branch now which day that week you will come in, and ask them to confirm the offer holds until then.
acted: SBI Global Ed-Vantage sanction letter: 24 Oct -> 10 Nov
